Name: Mayo Chicken
Author: jayjaydub
Description:
Pretty much exactly what it says on the description - Mayo colored hens!
They even produce eggs, which in turn can be used to make mayo!

Description of what's going on courtesy of Dodo (he writes better English than I do):

The MCU is a growing galaxy of unhinged mods with one common theme: Mayonnaise.  The great minds of the MCU gather on the [url=https://discord.gg/v9K3fkpWGz]Krobus Discord Server[/url]: a community for new and veteran Stardew Valley mod makers to collaborate, share, and learn from each other in the mod-making journey.
Join us!
